summary.text: Hillary Hickland is a Republican state representative from Texas House District 55 who took office on January 14, 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she named border security, lower energy costs and lower property taxes as her key campaign messages.

paragraphs.text: Hillary Hickland earned a high school diploma from Clovis High School, a bachelor's degree from Baylor University in 2005, and a graduate degree from Boston University in 2009.
Her career experience includes working as a stay-at-home parent.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Hickland described herself as a ninth-generation Texan, wife and mother of four who speaks Spanish and taught English in Mexico.

She said she was a Crisis Pregnancy Center mentor for 10 years, a member of Central Texas Republican Women, vice president of a local Daughters of the Republic of Texas group, and a PTA vice president for two years.
She listed school safety, lowering property taxes, government efficiency and accountability, and supporting the military among the policy areas she is passionate about.
